basic_profile.bio: Avid collector of action figures, particularly those from manga and anime series. Originally from Norway, I spend most evenings browsing threads about collectibles and Scandinavian culture. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. Single and enjoy attending local pop culture conventions. My typical online hours are late evenings, especially after 8 PM CET.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in Japanese pop culture and collectibles, primarily self-taught through years of engaging with online communities and reading niche blogs. I also have some formal education in design, which helps in appreciating the aesthetics of action figures.
